column1: ## Applied after base strip. Specific to traffic classification, threat scoring, and module extensibility.

column4: Threat scores (0-100) must be calibrated. A score of 80+ means high confidence of malice. Do not inflate scores for minor anomalies.
AbstractHeuristic subclasses and IHeuristicModule implementations operate independently. One module's failure must not corrupt another's findings.
Rapid connections trigger rate heuristics, but legitimate burst traffic (API clients, load tests from known IPs) must have configurable exemptions.
Every finding in the findings list must reference the specific evidence (timestamp, IP, port, payload) that triggered it. No unexplained classifications.
